title: Changes of Tier, Dues Cycle and Dependents on a Linden Membership
content:
A member of Linden Memberships may change tier or cycle on the existing membership. A change of tier, of dues cycle or of the number of dependents is recorded on that same membership, which then shows the tier, the cycle, the dues per cycle and the dependents after the change, and the date the change takes effect as its last tier change date.

## Rule

1. **Upgrade.** An upgrade takes effect per the target tier's upgrade timing: immediately, with the prorated difference for the rest of the month billed where the tier provides for upgrade proration, or at the next period.
2. **Downgrade.** A downgrade takes effect at the next period.
3. **Minimum interval.** A tier change is made no earlier than the tier's minimum interval counted from the previous tier change. The interval is counted in calendar months from the last tier change date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of the month, and a change on that day is allowed.
4. **Commitment.** Moving to a tier with a longer commitment restarts the commitment from the change date.
5. **Status.** The membership status is active when the tier is changed.

The last tier change date and the status are read from the membership record.

## Upgrade and downgrade at a glance

| Change | Takes effect |
|---|---|
| Upgrade into a tier whose upgrade timing is immediate | Immediately; the prorated difference for the rest of the month is billed where the tier provides for upgrade proration |
| Upgrade into a tier whose upgrade timing is the next period | At the next period |
| Downgrade | At the next period |

## Minimum interval: boundary cases (hypothetical dates and intervals)

| Last tier change date | Minimum interval | Earliest change allowed | Day before |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 January | 3 months | 12 April | 11 April: not allowed |
| 31 August | 6 months | 28 February (29 February in a leap year), since 31 February does not exist | 27 February: not allowed |
| 30 November | 3 months | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) | 27 February: not allowed |
| 5 May | 12 months | 5 May of the following year | 4 May: not allowed |

## Status

| Membership status at the time of the change | Change can be made |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes, subject to the interval |
| Pending, frozen, past due or cancellation pending | No |

## Commitment on a move (hypothetical)

A member moves on 1 September to a tier whose minimum commitment is longer than that of the current tier. The commitment restarts from 1 September.
